downward_contract: Reuse projection weights across at most four target rows while preserving scalar Decode finite-precision arithmetic and every complete commit prefix.

implementation.numerics: Four independent FMA chains per row, exact parenthesized merge and warp/block reduction, scales and BF16 publication unchanged. Same scalar norm/Conv/GDN/RoPE/Attention/argmax.
implementation.state: Assemble each complete Conv/GDN prefix layer by layer; append-only causal KV; finish normalized hidden/full logits and finite checks before publishing any snapshot.
implementation.scratch: Reuse existing validated C512 workspace; no new allocation or hot-path growth.
